name: Listen together
description: Listen along with friends: host a room on a melody-together server, join one with an invite, and -- at a party -- suggest tracks and vote

settings.label: Server
settings.help: Where your melody-together runs, e.g. https://together.example.org -- for hosting

settings.label: Server password
settings.help: The password the server makes rooms with; listeners need only an invite

settings.label: Room name
settings.help: What your room is called in its address, e.g. friday-doom; empty, a name is made

settings.label: Invite
settings.help: The invite a friend sent: paste it here, then Workspace › Run › Join the listening room

settings.label: Your name
settings.help: How the others see you; empty, your login name
